# GitHub Actions Output Formatter for `bivvy lint`

## Context

Bivvy's lint system already has three output formatters (Human, JSON, SARIF) following a clean `LintFormatter` trait pattern. This change adds a fourth formatter that emits GitHub Actions workflow commands (`::error::`, `::warning::`, `::notice::`), causing lint diagnostics to appear as inline PR annotations in GitHub Actions CI.

## Files to Change

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `src/lint/output/github.rs` | **Create** — `GithubFormatter` struct + `LintFormatter` impl + tests |
| `src/lint/output/mod.rs` | **Edit** — Add `pub mod github`, `Github` enum variant, `pub use` |
| `src/lint/mod.rs` | **Edit** — Add `GithubFormatter` to re-exports |
| `src/cli/commands/lint.rs` | **Edit** — Import `GithubFormatter`, add `"github"` match arm, add test |
| `src/cli/args.rs` | **Edit** — Update `--format` help text to include "github" |

## Implementation

### 1. `src/lint/output/github.rs` (new file)

- `GithubFormatter` unit struct (no fields, like `JsonFormatter`)
- `new()` constructor + `Default` impl
- `severity_to_command()`: `Error` → `"error"`, `Warning` → `"warning"`, `Hint` → `"notice"`
- Two escape helpers:
  - `escape_property()`: `%`→`%25`, `\r`→`%0D`, `\n`→`%0A`, `:`→`%3A`, `,`→`%2C`
  - `escape_message()`: `%`→`%25`, `\r`→`%0D`, `\n`→`%0A`
- `LintFormatter::format()` emits one line per diagnostic:
  ```
  ::{command} file={file},line={line},col={col},endLine={endLine},endColumn={endColumn},title={rule_id}::{message}
  ```
  - Omit `endLine`/`endColumn` when `end_col == usize::MAX` (the `Span::line()` sentinel)
  - Append suggestion to message with `%0A` separator when present
  - No summary line (unlike human formatter)

### 2. `src/lint/output/mod.rs`

- Add `pub mod github;`
- Add `Github` to `OutputFormat` enum
- Add `pub use github::GithubFormatter;`

### 3. `src/lint/mod.rs`

- Add `GithubFormatter` to the `pub use output::{...}` line

### 4. `src/cli/commands/lint.rs`

- Import `GithubFormatter`
- Add `"github"` arm in `format_output()` match (creates `GithubFormatter::new()`)
- Add `lint_github_format` test (mirrors existing `lint_json_format`/`lint_sarif_format`)

### 5. `src/cli/args.rs`

- Update doc comment: `/// Output format: human, json, sarif, github`

## Tests

**Unit tests** in `src/lint/output/github.rs`:
- Severity mapping for all three variants
- Error with span → correct `::error file=...,line=...,col=...::` output
- Warning without span → `::warning title=rule-id::message`
- Hint maps to `::notice`
- Suggestion appended with `%0A` separator
- Multiple diagnostics → multiple lines
- Empty diagnostics → empty output
- `Span::line()` sentinel → `endLine`/`endColumn` omitted
- Special characters escaped in properties and messages

**Integration test** in `src/cli/commands/lint.rs`:
- `lint_github_format` — valid config with `format: "github"` returns success

## Verification

```bash
cargo test --all-features
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo fmt -- --check
cargo doc --no-deps --all-features
cargo build --release
```

name: Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact-names:
        description: "Comma-separated list of artifact names"
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.artifact-names }}
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-linux-x64:
    name: Build (linux-x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release
          tar -czvf bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz bivvy
          mv bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz ../../../

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bivvy-linux-x64
          path: bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30

name: Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact-names:
        description: "Comma-separated list of artifact names"
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.artifact-names }}
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-linux-x64:
    name: Build (linux-x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release
          tar -czvf bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz bivvy
          mv bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz ../../../

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bivvy-linux-x64
          path: bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact-names:
        description: "Comma-separated list of artifact names"
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.artifact-names }}
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-linux-x64:
    name: Build (linux-x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release
          tar -czvf bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz bivvy
          mv bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz ../../../

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bivvy-linux-x64
          path: bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30

name: Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact-names:
        description: "Comma-separated list of artifact names"
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.artifact-names }}
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-linux-x64:
    name: Build (linux-x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release
          tar -czvf bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz bivvy
          mv bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz ../../../

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bivvy-linux-x64
          path: bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30

name: Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact-names:
        description: "Comma-separated list of artifact names"
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.artifact-names }}
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-linux-x64:
    name: Build (linux-x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release

name: Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact-names:
        description: "Comma-separated list of artifact names"
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.artifact-names }}
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-linux-x64:
    name: Build (linux-x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release
          tar -czvf bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz bivvy
          mv bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz ../../../

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bivvy-linux-x64
          path: bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30

name: Build

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact-names:
        description: "Comma-separated list of artifact names"
        value: ${{ jobs.summary.outputs.artifact-names }}
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-linux-x64:
    name: Build (linux-x64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Archive
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release
          tar -czvf bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz bivvy
          mv bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz ../../../

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bivvy-linux-x64
          path: bivvy-linux-x64.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30
